# Practice: Revise the record

Use the explicitly synthetic observations 1, 2 and 6.

1. Calculate the mean and show your calculation.
2. Write a short evidence record identifying the inputs and result.
3. Explain how this record differs from the worked example.

## Feedback rubric

| Criterion | Complete evidence |
|---|---|
| Calculation | Inputs, sum, denominator and result are correct |
| Reproducibility | Another learner can repeat the calculation |
| Interpretation | Changes are described without claims about a real population |

Submit only the requested exercise artifact. Do not include personal or
confidential data in public course repositories.
